fields.label: Week commencing (Monday)
fields.description: Requester: select the Monday of the week being logged.

fields.label: Your full name
fields.description: Enter the name you want recorded on your weekly work log.

fields.label: Project / workstream
fields.description: Which project or workstream did you work on this week?

fields.label: Monday: skipped / no work
fields.description: Tick this if you did not work on Monday. No summary, image, timelapse or time is needed for a skipped day.

fields.label: Monday: recorded work minutes
fields.description: Enter actual minutes captured while working. For example, 90 minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes.

fields.label: Monday: development log
fields.description: What did you build, change, try or learn today? Include useful detail, even if the result was a blocker or failed experiment.

fields.label: Weekly progress and reflection
fields.description: Summarise the main progress, what you learned, and anything that did not go as planned.

fields.label: I need help
fields.description: Tick this if you would like a staff check-in, technical support or help getting unstuck.

fields.label: Help needed / blockers
fields.description: If you ticked help needed, explain the blocker and the kind of support that would help. Otherwise this is optional.

fields.label: Your signature
fields.description: Review the week, time total, evidence and support request, then draw your signature.

fields.label: Date signed
fields.description: Enter the date you sign this weekly work log.

fields.label: Emails sent
fields.description: Work-related emails you sent during this week.

fields.description: Tasks or work items you completed during this week.

fields.label: Deliverables completed
fields.description: Issues resolved, releases shipped, or other completed outcomes.
